title: 3dTshift
description: Shifts voxel time series from input so that separate slices are aligned to the same temporal origin.

verbose.title: Verbose
verbose.description: Print lots of messages while program runs.

value.title: TR Value
value.description: The TR value. Must be greater than 0.

anyOf.description: Manually set the TR instead of using the value in the dataset header. You can attach a suffix for units.

tr.description: Manually set the TR instead of using the value in the dataset header. You can attach a suffix for units.

tzero.title: Time Zero
tzero.description: The time offset to align to. Must be between the minimum and maximum slice temporal offsets.

anyOf.title: Align to Time Zero
anyOf.description: Align each slice to a specific time offset.

slice_index.title: Slice Index
slice_index.description: The index of the reference slice. Must be less than the total number of slices.

anyOf.title: Align to Slice
anyOf.description: Align each slice to the time offset of a reference slice.

voxshift_file.title: Shift Dataset
voxshift_file.description: Dataset containing fractional TR shift values. Must have the same spatial dimensions as the input.

anyOf.title: Voxel-wise Shifting
anyOf.description: Shift each voxel by a different amount specified in a dataset. Values are fractions of a TR (positive means shift backwards).

shift_strategy.title: Shifting Strategy
shift_strategy.description: How to determine the temporal alignment target. Default is the average of the tpattern values.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix for output file name. Default is 'tshift'.

ignore.title: Ignore Initial Points
ignore.description: Ignore the first 'ii' points. These values will be unchanged in the output and will not be used in detrending or time shifting. Default is 0.

anyOf.title: Remove Mean & Trend
anyOf.description: Remove the mean and linear trend before shifting. Do not put them back.

anyOf.title: Remove Trend, Add Mean
anyOf.description: Remove the mean and linear trend before shifting. After shifting, put back only the mean.

anyOf.title: No Detrending
anyOf.description: Do not remove or restore linear trend. Default interpolation becomes heptic if Fourier was set.

detrend_strategy.title: Detrending Strategy
detrend_strategy.description: How to handle the mean and linear trend during shifting. Default is to remove both before shifting and add both back after.

interp.title: Interpolation Method
interp.description: Interpolation method. Fourier (default) is most accurate but slowest. Linear is least accurate. Polynomials: cubic, quintic, heptic. Weighted sinc: wsinc5, wsinc9.

tpattern_file.title: Pattern File
tpattern_file.description: File containing temporal offsets (one per slice).

tpattern.title: Slice Timing Pattern
tpattern.description: Use specified slice time pattern rather than the one in the dataset header.

in_file.title: Input dataset
in_file.description: Input dataset to 3dTshift. Can include a sub-brick selector (e.g., prefix+orig[4..$]).
